learning_outcomes.text: Students should obtain knowledge of basic notions and concepts of the database technology which are necessary for correct design, implementation and use of database systems and database applications.

The students learn the fundamentals of database modeling and design, the relational data model, the standard SQL database language, the process of logical schema normalization, and the issues concerning logical database organization as well as the basic physical structures utilized in database systems.

syllabus_topics: life cycle of the database system
transformation of the conceptual database schema to implementation schema
bibliography: R. Elmasri, S. B. Navathe, Fundamentals of Database Systems, 6rd edition, Addison-Wesley, 2011
H. Garcia-Molina, J. Ullman, J. Widom, Database Systems: The Complete Book, 2nd edition, 2008
S. Abiteboul, R. Hull, V. Vianu, Foundations of Databases, 2010
degree: Computer Science / ICT (Institute of Informatics) - courses in English for exchange students
